scenarios.scenario: Anonymous or authenticated database clients read or mutate checkout_access_state
scenarios.rationale: RLS is enabled, client table privileges are revoked, and isolated PostgreSQL catalog assertions verify no anon/authenticated access.

scenarios.scenario: A client supplies another user's ID to create a restricted order
scenarios.rationale: The route passes auth.getUser() identity to service-only v4; route tests cover authenticated ownership and the DB gate verifies owner-mismatched checkout preparation is denied.

scenarios.scenario: Same-account concurrent requests bypass the three-strike cooldown
scenarios.rationale: The account row is locked before candidate scans; 12 concurrent requests all returned the same committed block deadline.

scenarios.scenario: A provider response arriving after order/link expiry creates strike evidence
scenarios.rationale: The isolated PostgreSQL gate persists a late provider response and asserts checkout_issued_at stays NULL.

scenarios.scenario: A denied request creates an order or triggers provider work
scenarios.rationale: The database gate confirms no order is persisted for denial; route tests confirm the provider is not called and HTTP 429 is no-store with Retry-After.

scenarios.scenario: Hidden payment status pages continue polling or stale JSON overwrites current state
scenarios.rationale: AbortController, visibility and stale-response cases pass in the targeted lifecycle suite; measured hidden polls fell from 20 to zero.

scenarios.scenario: Large volume of distinct accounts bypasses all request-level abuse controls
scenarios.rationale: This plan implements an account-local checkout cooldown; production edge rate limiting/monitoring and multi-account capacity remain outside the verified scope.
